=== incoming and outgoing
[-> A : in
A ->] : out
[<- A : back
A <-] : back right
[--> A
A -->]
[->> A
A ->>]
[-\ A
A -/]
[-// A
=== short
?-> A : short in
A ->? : short out
?<- A
A <-?
=== decorations
[o-> A
[x-> A
A ->o]
A ->x]
[ox-> A
A o->]
A x-> ]
=== both
[<-> A
A <->]
=== colored exo
[-[#red]> A
A -[#blue]->]
A -[dashed]>]
=== exo activation
[-> A ++ : act
A -->] -- : ret
[-> B ** : create
[-> B !! : destroy
[-> C +-+ : weird
=== exo url label
[-> A [[http://x.com]] : label
=== exo parallel anchor
& [-> A
{an} A ->] : x
=== exo return
[-> A ++ : call
return done
=== exo quoted
[-> "Long A" : x
"Long A" ->] : y
=== exo autoactivate
autoactivate on
[-> A : in
A -->] : out
[-->> A
